product.name: Grade & Condition System
product.description: Quality tiers for anything graded — used and refurbished goods, pre-owned fashion, produce classes, room classes, service levels: tiers with badges and colours, an explainer showcase, listing filters, warranty per tier, mapping to structured data, feeds and marketplaces, and per-unit inspection checklists with photos and shareable reports. Attaches to catalog items through item.*@1 or works with your own item ids; all data in the merchant's own database and photos in the merchant's own bucket.

elements.name: Tiers
elements.description: Your quality ladder (names, notes, order, hex or design-token colours, icons, applicability rules, count limit) and the tier of every item, variant and individually graded unit — set through the API, by a catalog attribute on item.created@1 / item.updated@1, or from inspections. Badges drop-in, headless or by API.

elements.name: Showcase
elements.description: The tier explainer block: headline, copy, bullet points, a video link and images per tier with the warranty period — as cards, a comparison table or tabs.

elements.name: Filters
elements.description: Tiers as a listing filter: options with item counts per collection, hide-empty and rules@1 visibility, single or multi select, the URL parameter, matching item ids and ordering items by tier.

elements.name: Warranty
elements.description: Days of cover, text templates ({days}, {period}, {tier}) and exclusions per tier, periods written in the shopper's language, and printable terms.

elements.name: Mapping
elements.description: Tier → external condition values from merchant-editable vocabularies (schema.org itemCondition and a shopping-feed condition ship as defaults): allowed values, fallbacks, per-item Offer properties, feed rows and a drop-in condition statement.

elements.name: Inspection
elements.description: Per-unit inspection checklists (pass/fail, scored and note items, weights, critical items, required photos), score → suggested tier, photos uploaded straight to the merchant's storage with presigned links that sign the content length, and a shareable report link per unit.

plans.name: Starter
plans.description: Tiers with badges, listing filters, warranty per tier and condition mapping; the showcase and inspections as add-ons.

plans.name: Pro
plans.description: Everything, with larger ladders, more vocabularies and checklists.
